channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cameron Johnson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cameron Johnson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cameron Johnson
item.description:
Nets coachJordi Fernandez on former Suns fan favorite Cam Johnson:

“He’s a fan favorite for us too, so he’s in the same role…He’s about all the right things and what we’re trying to do moving forward, so very, very happy to have him with us.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cameron Johnson, Nov 27, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Cameron Johnson
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on whether Cam Johnson will be on a minutes restriction:

“I wouldn't envision Cam playing more than he did that first game.”

Jacque Vaughn on Cameron Johnson, Nov 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Nic Claxton on Cameron Johnson
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn saidCam Johnson is closer to returning than Nic Claxton:

“They're both improving, but we listed Cam Johnson as doubtful, which probably means that he's closer to playing than Nic is.”

Nic Claxton on Cameron Johnson, Nov 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on Cameron Johnson
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Mikal Bridges on #Nets restricted free agent Cam Johnson:

“He definitely knows I want him here (in Brooklyn) and nowhere else.”

Mikal Bridges on Cameron Johnson, Jun 24, 2023. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Sean Marks on Cameron Johnson
item.description:
Sean Marks on Cam Johnson's free agency:

“Cam knows how we feel. We hope he's back... He's a big priority for us, there's no question of that.”

Sean Marks on Cameron Johnson, Apr 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Monty Williams on Cameron Johnson
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on Cam Johnson's shooting slump:

“You know the work that he puts in is gonna pay off.”

Monty Williams on Cameron Johnson, Feb 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.
